lines.say: blocks myostatin, a muscle protein that limits muscle growth
injected follistatin, the form sold, has no human safety or benefit data
walking distance improved over a year in 6 men with myositis given gene therapy
4 of 6 patients with Becker muscular dystrophy walked farther after gene therapy
biopsies after gene therapy showed less scarring and signs of muscle repair
bigger muscles in mice when follistatin was raised (mouse study)
reproductive hormones monitored in the gene-therapy trial, with no changes seen

ask: Is there any evidence that injected follistatin builds muscle in healthy people?
